newsitem.title: Zimbabwe: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN LIQUID MARKET.
newsitem.headline: ZIMBABWE MONEY RATES MIXED IN LIQUID MARKET.

text.p: HARARE, June 27 (Reutetr) - Short-term interest rates on Zimbabwe's money market were quoted mixed in quiet trade on Friday amidst a surplus of Z$46 million from foreign exchange inflows into the system.

"The market is relatively quiet and there were no (treasury bill) auctions today. But the market is in surplus of Z$46 million from foreign exchange inflows probably from (ongoing) tobacco sales," one dealer said.
He forecast the market to end Friday's session with a surplus of Z$16 million.
Meanwhile, NCDs maturing after 30, 60 and 90 days were being bought at 27 percent from 25.5 percent and being sold at 25.75 percent versus 24.75.
Bankers acceptance bills were quoted firmer at 26 percent from 25.5 (buying) and were being sold at 25 percent from 24.75.
